desc: Prove/confirm the minimax-path/MST/Kruskal-tree equivalence and that an optimal matching equals matching greedily within the smallest merging components.
Design the DSU merge-time accumulation (Approach A): each root stores (unmatchedA, unmatchedB); union adds w*(min(sA_L,sB_R)+min(sA_R,sB_L)).
Implement Approach A end-to-end: fast input parsing, edge sort, DSU with surplus counts, 64-bit accumulation, stdout output.
Validate implementation on Sample 1 (expect 8) and Sample 2 (expect 3), plus edge cases K=1, duplicate A or B, weight ties.
Optimize for N,M up to 2e5 (iterative DSU with path compression/union by size, avoid Python recursion) and ensure within time limits.
